blocks.text: Helium-4 superfluidity ki sab se zyada study ki gayi misal hai. Yeh apne boiling point −452°F (−269°C ya 4 K) se kuch degree neeche liquid se superfluid ban jata hai. Superfluid helium-4 aam saaf liquid jaisa dikhta hai magar us mein viscosity nahi hoti; is liye ek dafa behna shuru kare to har rukawat ke paas se behta chala jata hai.

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text: Parachute ka bara area hawa ki rukawat (drag) barha deta hai, jo gravity ki force ka muqabla karti hai. Is se girne wale shakhs ki speed kam ho jati hai aur woh safe utar jata hai (5.13 aur 5.14 ka drag aur terminal velocity).
